Put away that horrified look. And take your hand off your sword.
strings.아가슈라의 수장이 이곳까지…. 무슨 일이지?: The leader of the Agasura, here...? What do you want?
I have business... No, a favor to ask.
strings.말로만 듣던 그 아가슈라?: The Agasura I've heard so much about?
strings.쉿, 만다라바. 지금 이 사람이 온 걸 아는 이는 우리뿐이야. 그러니 조: Shh, Mandarava. We're the only ones who know she's here. Keep quiet and act normally so Binah and Ruso don't notice.
strings.재미있는 정령이군. 어쨌든 오랜만이야, %s. 글래스턴을 떠난 건 알고: What an amusing spirit. Anyway, it's been a while, %s. I knew you'd left Glaston, but I didn't expect to find you here.
strings.어떻게 하면 마녀님께서 날 도와줄까? 필요한 게 있다면 말해. 당장 구해: How can I persuade our witch to help me? Tell me if you need anything. I could fetch it right away. Or would you prefer some useful information?
strings.간단히 말해. 여기 온 목적과 주겠다는 정보가 뭐야?: Get to the point. Why are you here, and what information are you offering?
strings.친구가 아파. 아가슈라라 일반적인 약이 듣질 않아. 네가 만든 약이라면: My friend is sick. Ordinary medicine doesn't work on an Agasura. I thought something you made might help...
strings.정보라면 이런 건 어때? 이 세계에 기생했던 럭스의 파편이라던가 하는 것: How about information on Lux's fragments and the like, those parasites on this world?
Very well. I'll make your medicine.
strings.(제릴이 글린다에게 약의 레시피가 적힌 듯한 종이를 건넨다.): (Jeril hands Glinda a sheet of paper that appears to contain a medicine recipe.)
strings.마침 재료는 다 있어. 그런데, 생소한 레시피네. 이 약을 먹고 어떤 증: I happen to have all the ingredients. But I've never seen a recipe like this. I have no idea what symptoms this medicine might cause.
strings.어떤 증상이든 상관없어. 원망하지 않을 테니 만들어주기만 하면 돼. 그리: Whatever happens is fine. I won't blame you. Just make it, and I'll never come back.
%s, stay with Jeril for a moment. This won't take long.
Thank you, witch. I'm counting on you.
strings.%s, 피곤해 보이는군. 쉬는 건 내가 간 다음에 하고. 지금은 약이 만: %s, you look tired. Rest after I leave. For now, listen to what I have to say while she makes the medicine.
strings.그러면 어떤 이야기를 듣겠어?: Then what would you like to hear?
strings.럭스의 최종 목적 정도는 알고 있겠지?: You know Lux's ultimate objective, don't you?
To steal the gift of foresight? No. To become a god...
strings.맞아. 잘 알고 있네. 지금은 여러 곳에 자신의 분신을 보내 뜻을 펼치고: Exactly. You know your stuff. He's sending incarnations of himself to various places to carry out his will. The human calling himself Aaron is one of them.
strings.그림자를 조각내서 다른 세계로 보내 장악하는 방식이지. 자기 뜻이 이뤄질: He splits his shadow into pieces and sends them to other worlds to seize control. Until he gets what he wants.
strings.지금 마계에서 럭스와 대적할 수 있는 자가 있다면 아마도 바르바토스 정도: If anyone in the Demon Realm can stand against Lux now, it's probably Barbatos...
strings.이상하게도 럭스와 바르바토스는 서로에게 전혀 손을 쓰지 않고 있어. 마치: Strangely, Lux and Barbatos haven't lifted a finger against each other. As if they have some unspoken agreement.
strings.어쨌든 그들 사이에 다프네가 관련된 건 너도 알고 있겠지? 거기다 검은: Anyway, you know Daphne is involved with those two, don't you? And the Goddess of the Black Moon is watching over it all. How very interesting...
strings.글린다에게 부탁한 약은 카즈노를 위한 거야. 조금이라도 더 버텨야 한다고: The medicine I asked Glinda for is for Kazno. He said he has to hold on a little longer, so I came all this way. I don't know how long medicine can keep him going.
He keeps losing Hilda. When does he think he'll ever summon Ouroboros and catch it?
Honestly, it's all such a bother. He never needed to catch Ouroboros in the first place...
strings.데르 족 소녀에게 관여하면서 그렇게 된 거지. 쓸데없는 고집 때문에 말이: It all happened because he got involved with that Der girl. Because of his pointless stubbornness.
strings.카즈노가 그냥 아가슈라의 본분을 지키고 살았으면 너도 지금의 네가 되지: If Kazno had simply lived as an Agasura should, you wouldn't be who you are now, either.
You don't understand. Yes, that's for the best.
I don't go to Glaston often, but when I visited this time, a lot had changed.
Perhaps it's because Aaron has left Glaston.
strings.마계를 다스리는 거대한 그림자 조각 하나가 사라져 제국에 빛이 들어온 것: One piece of the vast shadow that rules the Demon Realm disappeared, and light found its way into the Empire. That's all.
Tell me exactly what you mean.
Better you experience it yourself than hear it from me. If that's what has to happen anyway...
strings.(무슨 말을 들어도 다 모호해. 개운하지 않아.): (Everything she says is so vague. I don't feel any better.)
Frustrating, isn't it? But what can you do? Everything in this world has become your concern. You can't avoid it just because you want to.
strings.그래서 하고 싶은 말이 뭐야?: So what are you trying to say?
strings.지금은 때가 아니야. 내가 따로 찾아갈게. 카즈노도 여신님도 싫어하는 이: Now isn't the time. I'll visit you another day. I can't carelessly talk about things Kazno and the goddess both hate.
Though that depends on your choice, too... Ah, witch, finished? I like how quick you are.
I could only make about ten doses.
That's enough. It should keep him going for a while.
strings.버티기 힘들 때, 식후 30분 후에 복용하게 해. 약속대로 마을에서 나가: When he can hardly hold on, have him take it thirty minutes after a meal. Now leave the village as promised. And don't return.
strings.야박하지만, 어쩔 수 없지. 그러면 잘 지내, 마녀님. 모험가 %s, 나: Harsh, but I suppose I have no choice. Farewell, witch. Adventurer %s, I'll see you later.
strings.(제릴이 제자리에서 뛰어올라 마을 밖 호수 너머로 사라진다.): (Jeril leaps into the air and disappears beyond the lake outside the village.)
strings.그 아가슈라가 그대에게 무슨 말을 했는지 모르겠지만, 표정을 보니 알겠어: I don't know what that Agasura told you, but I can see it on your face. You need to leave Dorothy Village, don't you?
You must still be tired from your travels...
strings.항상 괜찮다고만 하는 게 그대의 성향일 테지. 알았어. 그러면 오늘은 푹: You always say you're fine. I suppose that's just your nature. All right. Get a good rest today and leave tomorrow.
strings.(아론이 사라졌다면 어디로 갔을까? 일단 글래스턴으로 가서 확인해 보는: (If Aaron has disappeared, where did he go? I'll have to go to Glaston and find out...)
strings.냥. 두분, 좀 더 머물면 안 되나요?: Meow. Can't you two stay a little longer?
I'd love to stay, but I have things to do.
strings.비나, 미안해여. 기사의 본분을 다하려면 도로시 마을에 계속 있을 수가: I'm sorry, Binah. I can't stay in Dorothy Village forever if I'm going to fulfill my duties as a knight.
strings.글래스턴에서 멀지 않으니까 자주 놀러 올게여. 오스카 가도 입구에다가 새: Glaston isn't far away. I'll visit often. I can leave fresh cotton by the entrance to Oscar Road, right?
Leticia thinks I'm a fish flapping around on a baited hook.
strings.(레티시아가 작은 솜뭉치를 호수를 향해 던진다. 그러자 만다라바가 후다닥: (Leticia throws a little ball of cotton toward the lake. Mandarava promptly flies after it and catches it.)
You've already learned how to handle Mandarava.
I'm fine. Thank you for looking after me while I was here.
It's only my duty as the village's owner.
It's kind of you to say that, Glinda.
strings.레티시아, 종종 놀러 오렴. 아, 놀러 오는 건 괜찮은데, 누군가와 함께: Leticia, do come visit now and then. Visiting is fine, but don't bring anyone with you. You understand?
Yes! We wouldn't want you killing innocent people, so I'll be sure to come alone.
That's true, but something about how you put it...
Boss, I don't think Letty means any harm.
By the way, where's Elliot? I haven't seen him.
Meow. We haven't seen Elliot since you went to Lindos, Adventurer.
He does disappear sometimes, but he's been gone quite a while this time.
%s, if you see Elliot, tell him to use the thing I gave him.
I'll tell him if I see him. We'd better get going, then.
Goodbye! See you all next time.
strings.(비나가 레티시아와 %s의 뒷모습이 보이지 않을 때까지 손을 흔들어 배웅: (Binah waves until Leticia and %s are out of sight.)
Wow, %s! We're almost back in Glaston already.
Letty, shh. Be quiet for a moment.
strings.레티, 거기서 뭐해?: Letty, what are you doing there?
strings.우와아아아아아, 까, 깜짝이에여! 모란 아저씨?: Waaaaah! Y-you startled me! Mr. Moran?
strings.어라, %s 님? 저야 항상 괜찮죠. 그런데 왜 여기서 나오세요?: Oh, %s? I'm always all right. But why are you coming out of there?
strings.모란 아저씨, 왜 아무 일도 없었던 것처럼 말씀하세여? 기사와 병사들이: Mr. Moran, why are you acting like nothing happened? The knights and soldiers... Mmph, mmph, mmph!
strings.읍. 읍. 읍. 입을 그렇게 막으면 대답 못 하잖아여!: Mmph! Mmph! I can't answer with your hand over my mouth!
Sorry. Moran doesn't seem to know anything...
strings.모란 아저씨는 항상 저런 표정이라 뭔가를 알아내긴 힘들어여. 근데 말하는: Mr. Moran always looks like that, so it's hard to tell what he knows. But the way he's talking, he really does seem clueless.
strings.%s 님, 우리 여기 있지 말고 실비아가 있던 자리로 가 봐여. 대충 이: %s, let's go to where Silvia usually is. She'll be slacking off around this time.
Mr. Moran, we were on patrol.
strings.아르젠트 단장님이 오스카 가도 쪽도 살펴보라고 허락하셨어여. 여기 증인도: Commander Argent gave me permission to check Oscar Road, too. I've got a witness right here. You know %s, right?
Oh, is that so? All right. I thought you'd gotten into trouble again.
strings.에이, 제가 매일 사고만 치는 줄 아시나여. 그럼 나중에 봐여, 모란 아: Come on, do you think all I do is cause trouble? See you later, Mr. Moran.
You must be busy. See you next time.
%s! Hurry! Let's go find Silvia slacking off.
strings.왜 사람은 계속 일해야 하는 걸까? 일주일에 나흘, 아니 사흘만 일했으면: Why do people have to keep working? I wish we only worked four days a week. No, three.
Ah, I'll just rest a little longer before going back.
Wow! That's Silvia for you. Slacking off, just as expected.
strings.바보야. 그런 거 아니라고 했잖아! 아, 레티? %s 님?: You idiot, I told you that's not what I'm doing! Oh, Letty? %s?
strings.언제 오셨어요? 괜찮으신 거예요? 그렇게 보내고서 정말 걱정 많이 했어요: When did you get here? Are you all right? I was so worried after sending you off like that.
A lot happened, but I'm fine.
strings.실비아, 있잖아. 모란 아저씨도 그렇고, 광장에 있는 사람들 말이야. 평: Silvia, you know... Mr. Moran and everyone in the square are acting completely normal.
The knights and soldiers passing through the square seem to be on ordinary patrol, too.
strings.나도 그게 이상했어. 아무도 그때 일을 기억하지 못하고 있어. 마치 누군: I thought that was strange, too. Nobody remembers what happened. It's as though someone erased only that memory.
As though their memories were erased...
strings.이상하게도 저는 기억하고 있어요. 모두가 잊었다면 저도 그 순간을 기억하: Strangely, I remember it. If everyone forgot, I should have forgotten that moment, too...
strings.어쨌든 아르젠트가 이 점에 대해서는 조용히 하고 있으랬어요. 말하면 황명: Anyway, Argent told me to keep quiet about it. He said talking about it would violate an imperial order.
strings.그 일 말고는 다들 괜찮은 거예요?: Aside from that, is everyone all right?
strings.네. 몇 번이나 확인했어요. 다들 평소처럼 일상을 보내고 있어요. 그 순: Yes. I've checked several times. Everyone's going about their lives as usual. I think the only ones who remember are you two, a few members of the Scar of the Red Moon knights, Her Majesty, my brother, and me.
strings.맞다, 레티. 오빠가 말을 전해주랬어. 글래스턴에 도착하면 평소처럼 행동: Oh, right, Letty. My brother asked me to pass on a message. Act normally when you return to Glaston.
strings.평소대로 순찰하면 되는 거겠지?: So I should patrol as usual?
strings.%s 님께는 폐하의 전언이 있었어요. 글래스턴에 오시면 어디 가지 말고: %s, Her Majesty had a message for you. She said to stay in Glaston and rest for a few days when you arrived.
strings.저는 그렇게만 들었어요. 아, 지금 시간이…. 아악, 선배가 찾으러 나오: That's all I was told. Oh, what time is... Aah! My senior's going to come looking for me!
strings.저는 사무실 들어가 볼게요. %s 님, 나중에 봐요. 레티, 나중에 내가: I'd better get back to the office. %s, see you later. Letty, I'll call you later.
Okay. Stop slacking off and get back in there.
strings.폐하 말씀대로 해야겠죠. 저는 라슈에트 여관에 있을 테니 무슨 일 있으면: I should do as Her Majesty says. I'll be at the LaChouette Inn. Come find me there if anything happens.
Okay! Let's have a meal together later. My treat! Hehe. Thanks for everything, %s.
strings.(아무래도 폐하를 뵙고 이야기를 들어봐야 할 것 같은데…. 언제 뵙지?): (I really need to speak to Her Majesty and hear what happened... When will I get to see her?)
I patrolled from the square to the administrative district. Nothing happened.
strings.저 없는 사이에 무슨 메시지 받은 건 없죠?: No messages came while I was away, did they?
Hmm. How long am I supposed to wait...?
The commander must be really busy, too. I haven't seen him for days.
Do you know that person, %s? She saw you and is coming this way...
My clothes change a little and you don't recognize me? I'm a little hurt.
It's been a while. This is...
strings.당신은 아르젠트 단장 밑에 있는 자유 기사 레티시아지?: You're Leticia, the free knight serving under Commander Argent, correct?
strings.맞아여. 그런데, 누구시져?: That's right. But who are you?
My name is Lena Hyren. I'm here to speak with %s.
strings.하이렌, 하이렌?! 아! 들어봤어여. 유명한 귀족 집안이잖아여. 제국 최: Hyren, Hyren?! Oh! I've heard of you. You're a famous noble family! I heard you run the Empire's finest brewery, too.
I'm glad you've heard of us.
strings.레나 씨, 그런데 무슨 일로…? 아, 이 이야기를 레티가 들어도 될까요?: Lena, what brings you here...? Oh, is it all right for Letty to hear this?
strings.폐하께서도 기사 레티시아에 대해서 알고 계신다. 크게 문제 될 내용도 아: Her Majesty knows about Knight Leticia. It's nothing particularly sensitive. She may listen.
I believe Commander Argent told her.
Wow! Wow! I'm going to tell Mom when I get off work!
strings.비밀 임무에 대해선 함구하고, 폐하께서 레티시아를 알고 있다는 것만 말씀: Keep your secret mission to yourself. You may only tell her that Her Majesty knows of you.
strings.당연하져. 저 지금까지 임무에 대해서는 단 한 번도 가족에게 말 한 적: Of course. I've never told my family a single thing about my missions.
Her Majesty is waiting. Follow me.
strings.그동안 네가 글래스턴에 드리운 위험을 제거했고, 제국의 그림자에 우뚝 섰: I know you've removed the danger hanging over Glaston and dealt with the Magic Bureau, which towered in the Empire's shadows.
strings.폐하의 명으로 우리도 그쪽 일을 살펴보고 있었지. 명색이 은의 발톱 요원: We were looking into it as well on Her Majesty's orders. We call ourselves Silver Claw agents, yet it seems we left everything to you.
strings.괜찮아요. 아, 그런데 그 사람에 관해선 기억하시나요?: It's all right. Oh, do you remember that man?
Aaron, I believe. I do have a distinct feeling that there was someone by that name.
strings.주민들은 그를 기억 못 하지만, 폐하 곁에 있는 나를 비롯해 요원 몇몇은: The residents don't remember him, but I and a few other agents close to Her Majesty seem to remember him vaguely.
The man who tormented the imperial family and Her Majesty so relentlessly...
There's something I'd like to ask...
I wondered how much you know.
strings.어느 정도 흐름은 파악하고 있어. 이 일에 마녀와 마족, 그리고 아론이: I have a general understanding. That witches, demons, and Aaron are involved...
And that these events threaten the goddess's safety.
strings.은의 발톱에서는 제국에 위협이 될 수 있는 부분들을 정리하는 중이야. 네: The Silver Claw is dealing with anything that could threaten the Empire. Our aims may differ somewhat from yours.
It's quiet around here, though. As if there's no one around...
strings.일부 관청을 폐쇄하고 출입을 통제하고 있어. 폐하가 왕림하셨기 때문은 아: We've closed some government offices and restricted access. Not because Her Majesty is visiting, but because we're purifying the demonic power left over from the previous incident.
Wait here a moment. I'll bring Her Majesty.
strings.(카이나가 종종걸음으로 %s에게 다가가 두손을 꼭 잡는다.): (Kaina approaches %s with quick little steps and clasps both of their hands.)
Your Majesty, I will withdraw with Lady Lena while you speak with %s.
strings.아니에요. 여기 있어도 돼요. 레나도 여기 있어줄래요?: No, you may stay. Lena, will you stay as well?
strings.%s, 지금 글래스턴의 모습은 어떤 것 같아요?: %s, what do you think of Glaston as it is now?
strings.평화로운 일상을 보내고 있는 도시, 그 자체 입니다. 불행한 일들이 일어: It's a city going peacefully about its daily life, completely unaware of the terrible things that nearly happened...
strings.글래스턴은 원래 그래야만 하는 도시지만,. 그렇지 못했던 건 아론이 했던: That is how Glaston should always have been. My predecessors and I failed it by not realizing what Aaron was doing.
strings.%s 덕분에 그가 제국에 자행한 악행을 멈출 수 있었지만, 아직도 그의: Thanks to you, %s, we stopped his crimes against the Empire. But traces of him still remain.
strings.마계 군주의 분신 같은 아론이 글래스턴에서 모습을 감췄을 뿐인데…, 주민: Aaron, an incarnation of a ruler of the Demon Realm, merely vanished from Glaston... and his existence disappeared from the people's memories.
As though someone erased the city's memories...
strings.%s, 누가 그렇게 했는지 짐작 가시죠?: %s, you can guess who did that, can't you?
That is why I asked you here today.
strings.그 마녀, 토끼 귀를 가지고 있었죠?: That witch had rabbit ears, didn't she?
A woman with rabbit ears was walking along a coast filled with pink salt crystals. She was looking toward a village near the cliffs.
A place like that would be...
I believe it is Salar Coast in Alfheim, and Nidaros, the village of the Dokkalfr.
As expected, Lena. You recognized it from the description alone. And...
strings.거대한 비공정 속 아론의 모습이 보였어요. 현재 실바리아 제국이 운행하고: I saw Aaron inside an enormous airship. It was somehow different from the airships currently operated by the Silvaria Empire.
Though I cannot say exactly how it differed...
strings.폐하, 혹시 예지 속에 바르바토스는 없었나요?: Your Majesty, was Barbatos in your vision?
No. I did not see him.
I understand. I'd better go there right away.
strings.제가 글래스턴을 떠난 후, 그 마녀의 목적을 알게 됐습니다. 목적을 이루: After leaving Glaston, I learned that witch's objective. I also learned she won't stop until she achieves it. I'd like to see for myself.
strings.그 목적이 무엇인지 이야기해 줄 수 있나요?: Can you tell me what that objective is?
strings.레나, 잠시 자리를 비켜주겠어요?: Lena, would you give us a moment?
strings.(카이나에게 다프네의 목적을 간단히 설명한다.): (I briefly explain Daphne's objective to Kaina.)
I see. So that happened after Aaron and the witch fell out...
strings.%s, 일단 니다로스에 가신다면 상황을 먼저 파악하고 움직이세요. 그리고: %s, if you go to Nidaros, assess the situation before you act. And if you need help, speak with Lena.
strings.다른 요원들과 함께 아론을 비롯, 관련된 마족들의 행방을 쫓고 있었습니다: We have been tracking Aaron and the demons connected to him. I was focusing on Glaston...
strings.그렇다면 니다로스로 행동 반경을 조금 옮겨도 괜찮을까요?: Then would it be possible to move your area of operations to Nidaros?
%s, Lena will show you the way to Nidaros. Go together.
strings.부담가질 필요 없어, %s. 당신은 당신의 일을, 나는 내 일을 하러 가: Don't feel burdened, %s. You'll be doing your job, and I'll be doing mine.
If you put it that way... Thank you, Your Majesty. Thank you, Lena.
I wish I could be of more help...
You have done more than enough, Your Majesty.
strings.폐하, 하나만 여쭤봐도 될까요?: Your Majesty, may I ask one thing?
strings.혹시 제가 그들을 만나거나, 그 후에 벌어질 일들을 보시지는 않았나요?: Did you happen to see me meeting them, or what happens afterward?
strings.네, 거기까진 보지 못했어요. 그게 보였다면 말씀드렸을 거예요. 아, 벌: No, I did not see that far. I would have told you if I had. Oh, is it that late already...?
%s, I'm sorry, but I must be going.
%s, Lena, until next time. This way, Your Majesty.
strings.(아르젠트가 떠나는 카이나를 호위하며 행정지구 안쪽으로 사라진다.): (Argent escorts Kaina away into the administrative district.)
strings.레나 씨, 그러면 우리도 갈까요? 그런데 니다로스는 어떻게 가나요?: Lena, shall we go, too? How do we get to Nidaros?
strings.리프트라시르에 북동쪽 해안가로 이어지는 길이 있어. 일단 가서 리프 님께: There's a road in Lifthrasir leading to the northeastern coast. Let's go and pay our respects to Lif first.
strings.료스알프에서 도크알프로 가려면 마을 수장의 허락을 받아야 해. 반대로 도: To travel from Ljosalfr territory to Dokkalfr territory, you need permission from the village leader. The same applies the other way around.
I have something about my assignment to pass on to another agent...
I'll wait in Lifthrasir. I'll go ahead and speak to the director.
All right. See you in Lifthrasir.
strings.(레나가 행정지구에서 황성이 보이는 길을 향해 달려간다.): (Lena runs from the administrative district toward the road overlooking the imperial palace.)
Whew. Nidaros... I'd better get ready and go.
strings.반짝반짝 달빛 아래 수정빛 숲속 ♬ 맑고 고운 이슬 맞고 깨어나요 ♬: Under twinkling moonlight, in the crystal forest ♬ We wake to drops of clear and lovely dew ♬
strings.아침의 엘프 우리 모두 노래해요 ♬ 리프트라시르의 빛이 다가와요 ♬: Elves of the morning, let us all sing ♬ The light of Lifthrasir is drawing near ♬
Under twinkling moon... Oh, %s? It's been a while.
strings.소장님, 방금 부르신 노래…. 처음 듣는 곡인데요? 어디 언덕 위에 있는: Director, that song you were singing... I've never heard it before. It sounds like something students would sing at a school on a hill.
strings.혹시 이어지는 부분이 '수정달 숲 정기 받아~' 이런걸까요?: Does the next part happen to go, 'Blessed by the spirit of Crystal Moon Forest~'?
Huh? Huh? Wow, how did you know? You said you'd never heard it!
strings.글쎄요. 저도 잘 모르겠어요. 그냥 맞춰 봤을 뿐인데, 이렇게 놀라실 줄: I don't know, either. I was just guessing. I didn't expect you to be so surprised...
It's a children's song passed down for generations among Lifthrasir's children.
Anyway, are you here to see me? Or...
How do you know what I'm going to say? Turning everything down like that... How heartless.
I'm sorry. I have too much to do.
strings.언제라도 마음이 바뀌면 이야기해요. 오늘 절 찾아온 이유도 할 일 중 하: Tell me if you ever change your mind. I suppose one of those things brought you here today?
strings.네. 갑자기 일이 생겨서 니다로스로 가야 해서요. 료스알프에서 도크알프로: Yes. Something came up, and I need to go to Nidaros. I heard I need your permission to travel from Ljosalfr territory to Dokkalfr territory.
strings.그렇다면 바로 허락해 드릴게요. 니다로스에간다면 주점 '애시 트리'를 운: Then you have it. If you're going to Nidaros, give my regards to Embla, who runs the Ash Tree tavern.
And tell her I'm sorry I couldn't be there for what happened with Stellan.
Thanks to you, I can send her my regards. Thank you, %s.
strings.그러고 보니, 외지인이 알프헤임의 다른 지역으로 갈 때, 마을 촌장에게: Come to think of it, outsiders have needed permission from village chiefs to travel between regions of Alfheim for a very long time.
strings.료스알프와 도크알프의 사이가 좋지 않을 때는 왕래가 힘들어서 허락을 받은: When relations between the Ljosalfr and Dokkalfr were poor, travel was difficult. Only those with permission could cross.
strings.엘프들도 그런 지경인데, 사정 모르는 인간들이 갔다가 곤란을 겪은 일도: Even elves had trouble, so humans unfamiliar with the situation often got themselves into difficulties.
strings.요즘엔 촌장의 허락 대신 편의상 공식 방명록에 서명하는 것으로 대신하고: These days, for convenience, we just have visitors sign the official guestbook instead of asking the chief's permission.
strings.소장님, 이거 방명록 아니잖아요. 누가 봐도 리프트라시르와 관련된 계약서: Director, this isn't a guestbook. It looks very much like a contract involving Lifthrasir.
Oops, you caught me. Just kidding! Here, this is the real guestbook.
Oh, what a shame. I was going to get you to settle here for good...
I can hear you, Director. Anyway, thank you.
strings.후후, 뭘요. 시간이 벌써 이렇게 됐네요. 오늘은 내가 바빠서 더 이야기: Hehe, you're welcome. Goodness, look at the time. I'm busy today, so I'm afraid I can't talk any longer.
strings.(흐음, 레나 씨는 언제 오는 거지? 아, 저기 온다.): (Hmm. When will Lena get here? Oh, there she is.)
strings.늦어서 미안. 리프 소장님께 말씀드렸지?: Sorry I'm late. Did you speak to Director Lif?
strings.네, 간단하게 방명록에 서명하면 된다고 하시더라고요. 레나 씨는 방명록: Yes. She said we only need to sign the guestbook. Have you signed it?
strings.소장님과 함께 알프헤임의 역사를 들으면서 리프트라시르 그린 에일을 즐기고: I signed after listening to the history of Alfheim with the director, enjoying some Lifthrasir Green Ale, and making a donation to the village.
strings.제국과 알프헤임 간의 관계를 돈독하게 했다고 생각해. 부정적으로 생각하지: I consider it strengthening relations between the Empire and Alfheim. I'd rather you didn't look at it negatively.
Come on, %s. Nidaros is this way. Follow me.
strings.여기부터 살라르 해안이야. 처음 오면 이 신비로운 풍경에 정신 팔려서 시: This is where Salar Coast begins. On your first visit, it's easy to lose track of time admiring the mysterious scenery.
strings.와아…. 너무 아름다워요. 프레이오스 곳곳을 다녀봤지만, 여긴 정말 놀랍: Wow... It's beautiful. I've traveled all over Freios, but this is incredible.
strings.저 소금 결정들이 햇빛에 비쳐 여기저기서 반짝이는 모습이 너무 아름다워요: Those salt crystals glittering everywhere in the sunlight are so beautiful.
They may look like ore or rocks, but they're all salt crystals.
strings.구경도 좋지만, 조금 서두르는 게 좋을 거야. 니다로스에는 밤이 금세 찾: Enjoy the view, but we should hurry a little. Night comes quickly in Nidaros.
strings.와,%s 님. 오랜만이에요!: Wow, %s! It's been a long time!
...Who are you? I don't think we've met.
strings.섭섭하네요. 처음 본다니! 정말 생각 안 나세요?: That hurts! We've never met? You really don't remember?
strings.언젠가 절 본 적이 있다면 모른다고 하실 수 없을 텐데…. 이 얼굴을 기: If you'd seen me before, you couldn't possibly say you don't know me... How could you forget this face?
Very well. I'll give you a hint. The Twilight Cathedral...
strings.그곳에서 악한 힘에 잠식된 사제들을 두들겨 패셨죠? 그중에 제가 있었습니: You beat up the priests who'd been consumed by an evil power there, didn't you? I was one of them. Probably one of the priests somewhere on the second floor!
I fought so many people then that I can't remember who was who.
strings.하하하, 괜찮습니다. 덕분에 정신을 차릴 수 있었죠. 이 잘생긴 얼굴에: Hahaha, that's all right. You brought me back to my senses. And you beat me without leaving a scratch on this handsome face! Truly, the goddess's grace!
Allow me to introduce myself properly.
strings.저는 호드미스 교단, 불멸의 사제단 소속 사제 아스크렌입니다. 최근 최연: I am Askren, a priest of the Immortal Priesthood of the Hodmis Order. I recently became its youngest fifth-rank priest. Haha.
strings.하는 일은 대외비라 자세히는 말씀드릴 수 없지만, 꽤 큰 활약을 했답니다: My work is confidential, so I can't go into detail, but I accomplished quite a great deal.
strings.그 때문인지 마을 어르신들께서 [니다로스의 자랑, 5급 사제 아스크렌]이: Perhaps that's why the village elders are putting up a banner reading 'Nidaros's Pride, Fifth-Rank Priest Askren' and organizing a party for me. Hahahaha.
I hear that quite often, Lady Lena Hyren.
strings.사제님, 내 이름도 알고 있네. 뭐, 불멸의 사제단이면 내 이름 안다고: You know my name, too. Not that it's strange for someone from the Immortal Priesthood... You weren't waiting for us, were you?
Haha, this really is a coincidence. If you're that suspicious, ask the Order. I'm simply a priest enjoying a vacation to celebrate my promotion.
strings.아니면 리프트라시르의 리프 소장님께 여쭤보시든가요. 휴가 나왔다고 인사드: Or ask Director Lif in Lifthrasir. I went to greet her and tell her I was on vacation.
strings.니다로스는 제 고향입니다. 사제 일 때문에 휴가 아니면 돌아오지 못해서: Nidaros is my hometown. It's such a shame that my priestly duties keep me from returning except on vacation.
All right. I'll take your word for it since you're a priest.
Thank you. The goddess will be pleased.
strings.예전에도 살라르 해안을 거쳐 니다로스로 가긴 했지만, 매번 갈 때마다 길: I've been to Nidaros through Salar Coast before, but the route seems different every time. It's confusing.
strings.마침 저도 마을에 가던 중이었는데, 지름길로 같이 가시겠습니까?: I was just heading to the village myself. Would you care to take a shortcut with me?
strings.아스크렌 사제님. 길 안내를 부탁드려도 될까요?: Father Askren, could you show us the way?
Of course. It would be an honor.
Oh, but the shortcut has quite a few monsters. We'll have to clear them out as we go.
Leave that to me. There shouldn't be monsters on a road the villagers use.
strings.오오, 훌륭하십니다! 그러면 함께 처리해 볼까요?: Oh, how admirable! Shall we deal with them together?
strings.이 정도면 몬스터는 거의 정리된 것 같습니다. 기대했던 것보다 훨씬 훌륭: I think that takes care of most of the monsters. You're even better than I'd expected.
strings.사제님은 어떤 기대를 하고 있던 거지?: What exactly were you expecting, Father?
Your fighting skills are remarkable. Hehe.
strings.오늘 만남도 여신께서 이끌어 주신 것 같은데, 마을에 도착하면 제가 애시: The goddess seems to have brought us together today. May I buy you an Ash Wave when we reach the village?
strings.니다로스를 방문했는데, 애시 웨이브를 마시지 않았다? 그건 정말 프리링이: Visiting Nidaros without drinking an Ash Wave? That's like saying a Priring didn't eat its snack.
strings.무알코올도 있으니 안심하세요. 마스터인 엠블라가 맛있게 만들어 줄 겁니다: There's an alcohol-free version, too, so don't worry. Embla, the proprietor, will make you a delicious one.
That's the person Director Lif asked me to give her regards to.
strings.아스크렌 사제님, 마을까지 얼마나 남았죠? 이 정도면 지름길이라기에는 좀: Father Askren, how much farther is the village? This is a bit long for a shortcut...
strings.여기를 기준으로 남서쪽으로 내려가면 니다로스입니다. 저쪽에는 살라르 해안: Head southwest from here and you'll reach Nidaros. Over there is one of Salar Coast's spectacular sights, a great hole in the rocks.
strings.안으로 바닷물이 들어오고 빠지는 걸 볼 수 있는데, 니다로스의 엘프들은: You can watch the seawater flow in and out. The elves of Nidaros gaze at it and pray for everyone's well-being.
strings.바다에 나가는 어부들은 파도의 움직임을 가늠하기도 하죠. 그래서 그 구역: Fishermen heading out to sea also use it to judge the waves. That's why the area is called the Sea of Wisdom.
strings.그 장소에 얽힌 다른 이야기도 있지만, 기억이 잘 나지 않네요. 나중에: There are other stories about that place, but I can't quite remember them. Ask the villagers sometime.
All right, Father. Oh, but there's something over there...
I think there's something down here.
Something below this cliff? There's nothing but sand and sea.
Maybe the unfamiliar scenery gave you a strange feeling.
strings.아, 아무것도 아닙니다. 저도 오랜만에 바다를 보고 있자니 여러 생각이: Oh, nothing. Seeing the sea for the first time in a while has given me a lot to think about.
Nidaros is this way. Let's go.
strings.(방금 확실히 뭔가에 놀란 눈치 같던데….): (He definitely looked startled by something just now...)
strings.(그런 건 지금 신경 쓰지 말자. 빨리 마을에 가서 다프네가 뭘 하려는지: (I shouldn't worry about that now. I need to reach the village and find out what Daphne is planning.)
Thank you, Father. That's our lodging taken care of.
strings.뭘요. 귀한 손님께서 고향을 찾아주셨는데, 이 정도 편의는 당연히 제공해: Think nothing of it. Such distinguished guests have come to my hometown. Providing this much is only natural.
strings.니다로스에서 오신 목적이 무엇인지는 모르지만… 편히 일 보시고 잘 돌아가: I don't know what brought you to Nidaros... but I hope you can finish your business comfortably and return safely.
Father Askren. That smile looks awfully suspicious.
strings.제가 원래 잘 웃고 다녀서요. 하하. 이 미소에 안 넘어가는 사람이 없…: I'm always smiling. Haha. No one can resist this smi...
Suddenly pointing a gun at my head... That startled me.
strings.수작을 부릴 거면 티 나지 않게 해야지, 사제님. 우리를 계속 떠보는 거: If you're going to play games, be less obvious, Father. Did you think we'd ignore your constant attempts to sound us out?
I think there's been a misunderstanding...
Father Askren, what happens next depends on your answer.
strings.하아, 성격 급하시군요. 지금 말씀드리면 안 되지만, 죽긴 싫으니…. 이: Sigh. You're rather impatient. I'm not supposed to tell you yet, but I'd rather not die... Take a look at this.
strings.황실 인증 카드에 교단 서류네요?: An imperial identification card and documents from the Order?
strings.교단에서 %s 님을 도울 일이 생기면 도우라는 지시가 있었습니다. 일종의: The Order instructed me to help %s if the need arose. You could call it a support role.
The Pope's and Demigod Lydia's. Look here...
strings.교황님의 직인 맞고, 데미갓 리디아의 서명…. 이 필체는 전에 본 적이: That's the Pope's official seal, and Demigod Lydia's signature... I've seen that handwriting before. Confirmed. I apologize for the misunderstanding.
Haha, I can see why you misunderstood.
strings.어디까지 협력할 생각이죠?: How much help are you prepared to give?
strings.글쎄요. 앞으로 무슨 일이 생길진 모르겠지만, 머무시는 동안 최선을 다해: Well, I don't know what will happen, but I'll do everything I can while you're here.
I'm quite a useful priest, you know.
strings.%s, 저 사제 영 마음에 안 드는데, 바닷가에 던져 버릴까?: %s, I really don't like this priest. Shall I throw him into the sea?
Hahaha, you do like your jokes...
I'll be going now. If anything happens, let me know.
strings.마을 들어오기 전에 쉬었던 살라르 해안 근처나 마을 동쪽에서 쉽게 찾으실: You can easily find me near the part of Salar Coast where we rested before entering the village, or on the east side of town.
And if you need information, try Embla.
You're welcome. Haha. I'll take my leave, then.
strings.%s 보기에 저 사제 어때? 믿을 수 있을 것 같아?: %s, what do you think of that priest? Can we trust him?
strings.우리가 왜 여기 온 건지 어렴풋이 알고 있는 듯한 눈치던데…. 뭐, 어쩔: He seems to have some idea why we're here... Well, we have no choice. We'd better start asking around.
strings.얼마나 걸릴지 모르겠지만, 일단 이 시간까지 어때?: I don't know how long it will take, but how about we meet at this time?
That works. I'll meet you in front of the clock tower then.
(Let's look around the village and gather information... I need to find Daphne's trail quickly.)
strings.서두르긴 했는데, 아직도 물고기가 미끼를 물러 오질 않네요. 하아, %s: I hurried, but the fish still hasn't come to take the bait. Sigh. %s... I needed to finish this before you arrived...
...I'm beginning to regret wishing you quite so much luck.
strings.오늘은 일찍 들어가서 쉴까? 손님도 없고 아스크렌 얼굴 보는 것도 지긋지: Should I close up early today? There are no customers, and I'm sick of looking at Askren's face... Oof.
strings.(건물 밖으로 나와 기지개를 켜던 엘프 여성이 마침 다가오는 모험가와 눈: (An elven woman comes out of the building and stretches. Her eyes meet the approaching adventurer's.)
strings.편하게 엠블라라고 불러. 그런데 손님, 어떻게 나를 알아? 여기 사람은: Just call me Embla. How do you know me, though? You don't look local...
Director Lif in Lifthrasir asked me to give you her regards.
strings.리프 할머니가? 뭐라고 하셨어?: Grandma Lif did? What did she say?
That she's sorry she couldn't be there for what happened with Stellan.
strings.리프 할머니가 워낙 바쁘시고, 나도 그때는 마을에 없었으니까. 어쩔 수: Grandma Lif is so busy, and I wasn't in the village then, either. It couldn't be helped. Thank you.
strings.실례가 안된다면 무슨 일인지 여쭤봐도 될까요?: If you don't mind my asking, what happened?
strings.그 질문에 답하기 전에 나도 궁금한 게 있어. 손님은 누구야?: Before I answer, there's something I want to know. Who are you?
strings.리프 할머니 부탁을 받고 왔다면 보통 사람은 아닐 것 같은데?: If Grandma Lif sent you, you must be someone special.
strings.와아, 그게 당신이야? 엄청 대단한 사람이잖아! 몇 번이나 세계를 구했다: Wow, that's you? You're someone amazing! Even I've heard how you saved the world over and over.
strings.영웅이 겸손하기까지 하다니. 그런데 우리 마을엔 무슨 일이야? 단순히 안: A hero who's humble, too. What brings you to our village? I doubt you're just here to pass on a greeting...
strings.그 정도 가지고 놀라기는. 손님 같은 대단한 인물이 외딴 니다로스까지 왔: No need to look so surprised. If someone as remarkable as you comes all the way to remote Nidaros, you must have a reason.
strings.잘 찾아왔어. 여긴 작긴 해도 나름 주점이라 다양한 정보가 잘 들어오는: You came to the right place. It's small, but this is a tavern, so all kinds of information come through. My father left some behind, too.
strings.그렇군요. 그러면 몇 가지 여쭤봐도 될까요?: I see. May I ask a few things, then?
strings.지금 내가 마을 촌장 대행이라 손님에게 아무 이야기나 쉽게 할 수는 없거: I'm acting village chief right now, so I can't just tell a visitor anything they ask. That said, interested in a part-time job?
It's nothing difficult. Think of it as a deal. There are two jobs, and you can do them in either order. But you have to finish both. What do you say?
strings.그 일들이 다 끝나면 내가 아는 것들을 이야기해 줄게. 단, 질문 기회는: Once they're done, I'll tell you what I know. You get three questions.
strings.첫 번째 일이 궁금하다면 춤 연습하는 '카르멘'에게 가서 내 이야기를 해: For the first job, go to Carmen, who's practicing her dancing, and mention me. You'll soon find out what to do.
strings.두 번째로는 라스의 고민을 해결해 줬으면 좋겠어. 요즘 뭐가 문제인지 표: For the second, I'd like you to help Lars with his worries. I don't know what's wrong, but he's looked troubled lately... It seems to be something us adults can't help with.
Let's rest a little before going to Embla... Whew.
strings.(아스크렌 사제님이 이야기했던 유적, 그게 해안가 근처에서 느껴졌단 건데: (The ruins Father Askren mentioned... That's what I sensed near the coast...)
strings.(해안가를 지나가면서 눈여겨봤지만, 그런건 전혀 보이지 않았어. 대체 어: (I looked carefully as I passed the shore, but I didn't see anything like that. Where could they be...?)
strings.(아틀라스 정원처럼 하늘에 있는 것도 아닌듯 하고….): (They don't seem to be in the sky like Atlas Garden, either...)
There's something painted on the clock tower's glass.
strings.레나 씨, 언제 왔어요?: Lena, when did you get here?
strings.근데 저 유리 그림 말이야. 보통 저런 건 천사들이 두 팔을 벌려서 사람: About that picture on the glass... Usually angels in pictures like that spread their arms as though embracing someone...
This one's different. With its fists clenched, it looks ready for a fight.
strings.레나 씨는 뭔가 알아낸게 있나요?: Have you found anything out, Lena?
It seems someone I know has come to Nidaros. That's all I've found.
%s, sorry. I'm going to head back and rest.
strings.(레나 씨, 왜 그러지? 분위기가 조금 이상하네….): (What's wrong with Lena? She seems a little strange...)
strings.손님, 고마워. 카르멘 일도 그렇고, 라스 일도 그렇고. 다들 얼굴이 한: Thank you. For helping Carmen and Lars. Everyone looks much happier.
strings.다행이네요, 엠블라. 혹시 또 부탁할 일 있나요?: I'm glad, Embla. Is there anything else you need?
No, you've done plenty. Honestly, I didn't expect you to take on all of it.
I wanted to know what sort of person you were, so I asked too much of you. I'm sorry.
strings.마침 한가하니까 사과의 의미로 애시 웨이브 한 잔 줄게. 술이 아니라 청: It's quiet right now, so let me give you an Ash Wave by way of apology. It's a refreshing drink, no alcohol. Nothing to worry about.
Oh! That's really refreshing. It feels like it clears me right out.
strings.입에 맞는다니 다행이야. 그러면 시작해볼까? 자, 궁금한 거 뭐든 물어봐: I'm glad you like it. Shall we begin? Ask whatever you'd like.
He was my father. He passed away recently.
strings.손님이 뭐가 미안해. 그러면 아버지 이야기를 해볼까?: You have nothing to apologize for. Shall I tell you about him?
strings.아버지는 낮에는 촌장으로서 마을을 돌보고, 저녁에는 주점을 운영하던 특이: He was an unusual man. He looked after the village as chief by day and ran the tavern at night.
strings.하나 있는 딸이 주점을 물려받기를 원하셨지만, 나는 그게 싫어서 마을을: He wanted his only daughter to inherit the tavern, but I hated the idea and left the village. So I barely saw him.
We were the sort of father and daughter who'd say things the other hated and fight whenever we met.
strings.에스닐에 들러 쉬고 있을 때, 편지를 단 비둘기가 날아왔어. 아스크렌이: I was resting in Esnil when a pigeon arrived carrying a letter. Askren sent it. Father had died, and I needed to come home...
You don't know Askren, do you? He's...
I do. Father Askren showed me the way here.
strings.내일 일은 아무도 모른다고, 건강하시던 아버지가 하루아침에 허망하게 가실: Nobody knows what tomorrow will bring. Father was so healthy... I never imagined he'd be gone so suddenly.
strings.아스크렌이 마지막을 지켜봐 줘서 다행이야…. 해안가 절벽 근처에 쓰러져: I'm glad Askren was there for his final moments... Apparently Father had collapsed near the coastal cliffs.
I have no idea what made him collapse...
strings.(절벽…? 내가 이상한 걸 느꼈던 그곳인가?): (The cliffs...? Where I felt something strange?)
strings.며칠을 앓다 돌아가셨는데, 아버지가 유언이라면서 이상한 말을 남겼지 뭐야: He was ill for a few days before he died, and left these strange words as his will. Look.
strings.[나 스텔란은 아들 같은 아스크렌에게 애시 트리의 모든 서비스를 무상으로: [I, Stellan, grant Askren, who is like a son to me, all services of the Ash Tree free of charge. Should I be unable to provide them, my daughter Embla will continue to do so...]
strings.아스크렌이 고맙긴 한데, 아버지 유언장을 교단과 온갖 기관에 공증까지 해: I'm grateful to Askren, but he had Father's will notarized by the Order and every other authority he could find. So I have to follow it.
strings.하아…, 평소에 장난기 많은 아버지답다고 해야 할지…. 아스크렌하고는 죽: Sigh... I suppose it was just like Father. He was always such a prankster... He and Askren really hit it off.
He sounds like a cheerful man.
strings.그렇게 말해 줘서 고마워, 손님. 그런데, 이걸 정보라고 할 수 있을까…: Thank you for saying that. Though... can this really count as information?
strings.(엠블라의 아버지께서는 대체 뭘 보셨을까….? 나중에 확인해 봐야겠어.): (What on earth did Embla's father see...? I'll have to find out later.)
strings.중앙에 있는 시계탑 말하는 거지?: You mean the clock tower in the center?
strings.네. 지나가다 봤는데 유리 장식도 너무 예쁘고, 정각에 맞춰 울리는 종소: Yes. I saw it while passing by. Its glass decoration is beautiful, and the bell that rings on the hour has such a gentle tone.
strings.그거 말이지, 한 백 년쯤 됐나? 실바리아 제국에서 교류의 하나로 만들어: That? It's about a hundred years old, I think. The Silvaria Empire built it as part of an exchange.
strings.그 시절에는 엘프 마을에 시계탑을 세우는 게 유행이었거든. 니다로스 주민: Clock towers were popular in elven villages back then. I suppose the people of Nidaros wanted a landmark in the village center and asked for one.
strings.탑 유리에 뭔가가 그려져 있던데요?: There was something painted on the glass?
Our villagers believe there's an angel somewhere in the sea.
strings.마을에 나쁜 일이 일어나면 바다에서 신비한 노랫소리가 들려왔대. 듣기만: They say that when something bad happened to the village, mysterious singing would come from the sea. Hearing it calmed their hearts and helped them endure unbearable hardships.
That story has been passed down, and we still pray toward the sea. Simply wishing for happiness.
strings.진짜로 천사가 있는지 없는지 그건 중요하지 않아. 이런 따뜻한 믿음만큼: It doesn't matter whether an angel really exists. Nothing offers greater comfort than that warm belief.
strings.(천사가 지켜 주는 마을이라…. 혹시 미카엘라 님이나 라파엘라 님과 같은: (A village protected by an angel... Could it be a battle angel like Michaela or Raphaella?)
If you want to hear more about the angel, go see Grandpa Gregory.
strings.어린애들 재미있으라고 하신 이야기인지는 모르겠지만, 옛날에 직접 보셨다고: I don't know whether he was just telling stories to entertain the children, but he said he saw the angel himself long ago.
strings.(천사를 만난 할아버지? 흠, 일단 체크해 두자….): (An old man who met an angel? Hmm. I'll keep that in mind...)
Nidaros is remote, so outsiders don't come here often.
Most of the Ash Tree's customers are villagers whose faces I know.
That's why people from elsewhere, like you, stand out right away.
strings.찾는 사람이 있구나. 인상착의를 말해 봐. 기억나는 사람이 있을지도 모르: You're looking for someone, aren't you? Describe them. I might remember someone.
strings.얼굴에 상처가 있는 굳은 인상의 40대 중후반 남자인데, 실바리아 제국: A stern-looking man in his mid-to-late forties with a scar on his face. He's a noble of the Silvaria Empire.
strings.그런 사람은 못 봤어. 날카로운 눈매가 인상적인 젊은 귀족 남자를 본 적: I haven't seen anyone like that. I did see a young nobleman with strikingly sharp eyes. He looked incredibly cold.
I don't think that's who I'm looking for.
I'll tell you if I see someone like that.
strings.(날카로운 눈매를 지닌 귀족 청년이라…, 기억해두자.): (A young nobleman with sharp eyes... I'll remember that.)
That's all I can tell you.
It's nothing. I look forward to seeing you around.
But Embla... You're not asking anything else?
strings.손님은 손님의 일을 해. 우리는 우리의 일을 할게. 알았지?: You do what you need to do. We'll do what we need to do. All right?
That's an enormous tuna today. Thank you for always bringing us something.
Hoho. This is about all I can do for you.
strings.엠블라하고 자네 말고 또 누가 있나? 내가 좀 할 말이 있는데, 지금 괜: Who else is here besides you and Embla? I'd like a word. Are you free? I saw something strange.
strings.혹시 찾고 있는 이가 토끼 귀 여인인가?: Would you happen to be looking for a woman with rabbit ears?
strings.놀라는 걸 보니 그 수인이 자네가 찾는 이가 맞나 보군. 그렇다면 날 따: Judging by your surprise, that beastkin must be the one. Then follow me.
strings.엠블라, 난 이만 가마. 이 손님도 갑자기 용무가 생겨서 가 봐야 한다는: Embla, I'll be going. Something's come up for your guest, too.
Goodbye, Grandpa. You take care, too.
Never mind 'sir.' Call me Mr. Gregory. This way.
Here. This is where the woman with rabbit ears appeared.
I was going to tell you about the angel when we met, but the timing's awkward.
This would have been the perfect place for it, if that woman hadn't appeared.
strings.여기서 낚시하던 날 보고는 \"꼬마야, 나 못 본 거다\" 라고 하더니: She saw me fishing here and said, 'Kid, you didn't see me,' then jumped into the sea.
strings.내가 잘못 봤나 싶어 얼른 꺼내려고 했지만, 손이 닿지 않을 정도로 깊은: I wondered if my eyes were deceiving me and rushed to pull her out, but she'd already gone too deep to reach.
So I looked for you as soon as I got back to the village.
strings.꼬마라는 말을 들어 본 게 대체 얼마 만인지 원. 그건 그렇고 그 여인,: How long has it been since someone called me a kid? Anyway, is that woman a witch?
strings.부족하네만, 조금은 마력을 느낄 수 있다네. 그 여인은 일반적인 마법사와: I'm no expert, but I can sense a little magic. She seemed different from an ordinary mage...
strings.언젠가 천사님을 만났을 때, 마녀나 마족과 만난 게 아니어서 다행이라고: When I met the angel long ago, she said I was lucky I hadn't encountered a witch or a demon.
That was fifty years ago... but I remember it like yesterday.
strings.자, 잠깐만요. 그 말씀은 마녀나 마족을 만나면 큰일이라는 뜻이네요?: W-wait. Doesn't that mean meeting a witch or a demon would be disastrous?
strings.무모하네. 이 물구멍은 바다와 이어져 있어서 함부로 들어갔다가는 허공해: That's reckless. This hole connects to the sea. Jump in carelessly and you could be swept right out of the Void Sea.
strings.이걸 가지고 가게. 예전에 천사님께서 날 구했을 때 주신 것이지. 이것: Take this. The angel gave it to me when she saved me long ago. It let me breathe underwater on the way up... Though it doesn't seem to work now...
strings.그런 물건을 제게 주셔도 괜찮나요?: Are you sure you can give me something like that?
strings.언젠가 천사님이 자길 도울 수 있는 사람이 나타나면 이걸 주라고 하셨는데: The angel said to give it to someone who could help her, should such a person appear. I think that time has come.
Then prepare yourself properly before you go in.
strings.그 녀석, 성격 한번 급하구만. 벌써 저기까지 내려가 버렸네. 그러면 여: What an impatient youngster. Already all the way down there. Shall I wait here and fish, then...?
strings.(작은 파도가 일어나더니 바닷물이 천천히 검게 물들어간다.): (Small waves rise, and the seawater slowly begins to turn black.)
strings.(흐릿한 시야 사이로 신전 같은 유적 건물 일부가 보인다.): (Through the hazy view, part of a temple-like ruin comes into sight.)
strings.(왠지 모르게 코랄시티하고 비슷해 보이는데, 조금 다르긴 하네. 바다 안: (Somehow it looks a bit like Coral City, though it's different. To think there's a place to breathe like this underwater...)
strings.(아스크렌 사제님이 말한 유적이 여긴가?): (Are these the ruins Father Askren mentioned?)
strings.(천사의 깃털 때문에 살았지만, 여기서 어디로 가지? 일단 들어오긴 했는: (The angel's feather saved me, but where do I go now? I've made it inside...)
strings.(뭐지? 갑자기 커다란 그림자가….): (What's that? A huge shadow, all of a sudden...)
strings.어머, 침입자 주제에 용케도 피했네요. 아쉬워라. 한 번은 칭찬해 줄게요: Oh my, you dodged well for an intruder. What a shame. I'll compliment you once, but not twice.
strings.(정신을 차리고 앞을 바라보자, 금발에 푸른 눈을 지닌 한 여성이 주먹을: (Looking up after recovering, I see a woman with blonde hair and blue eyes standing with her fist tightly clenched.)
strings.저기, 당신은 뭐가 좋아요?: Tell me, which do you like?
Sparkling salt crystals, an ugly bonito, or crumbled ruins. Go on, choose.
strings.당신이 되고 싶은 거요. 고르기 힘들면 제가 추천해 줄까요? 제 생각엔: Which would you like to become? Shall I recommend one? I think salt crystals would suit you. They shatter so nicely.
strings.(그 말과 함께 여성이 허리에서 커다란 날개를 펼치며 순식간에 %s의 앞: (As she speaks, enormous wings spread from her waist, and she flies up to %s in an instant.)
strings.(스트레이트, 어퍼컷, 그리고 돌려차기까지 이어진 콤보 공격에 모험가가: (A straight punch, an uppercut, then a spinning kick send the adventurer crashing to the ground.)
strings.시끄러워요. 자기 말 들어달라고 했던 나쁜 놈들 때문에 얼마나 고생했는데: Quiet. Do you know how much trouble villains who asked me to listen have caused me? Whew...
strings.좋아요. 저는 천사니까 특별히 기회를 드릴게요. 몇 대 더 맞고 죽을래요: Very well. Since I'm an angel, I'll give you a special chance. Will you take a few more hits and die, or surrender and flee?
strings.아니, 천사가 뭐 이래요?!: What kind of angel acts like this?!
strings.어머, 천사에 대한 고정관념이 있으시네요. 그럼 다음 생에는 착하게 살: Oh my, you seem to have preconceived notions about angels. Then try living a better life in your next incarnation. Now... Huh?
strings.(그 순간, 천사가 누군가 천사의 손목을 붙잡는다.): (At that moment, someone grabs the angel's wrist.)
strings.누구세요? 누군데, 내 이름을 알고 있어요? 이 손 놓지 못해요?: Who are you? How do you know my name? Let go of my hand!
...Ugh. What are you? I-I can't move.
strings.당신, 왜 헤카테 님의 힘이…. 아니, 마족인가요?: Why do you have Hecate's power...? No, are you a demon?
strings.마족도 아니고, 헤카테 님의 힘이 살짝 있긴 하지만, 헤카테 님과는 달: I'm not a demon. I do have a little of Hecate's power, but I'm different from her.
strings.천사가 너무 뻔뻔하게 거짓말해서 재미있네요. 놓으면 바로 주먹질을 하시겠: How amusing, an angel lying so shamelessly. You'll swing at me the moment I let go.
Very well. I'll let you go, but I'll be taking the Star's Tear.
Hehe. I can't wait to see what you'll do to me, Gabriella. I'll go on ahead. Farewell.
strings.(그 말과 함께 눈 앞에서 다프네가 사라진다.): (With those words, Daphne vanishes before my eyes.)
Ah, this is maddening. She clearly knew where it was...
strings.(모험가가 제대로 설명하기도 전에 가브리엘라가 힘찬 날갯짓과 함께 어딘가: (Before the adventurer can explain properly, Gabriella beats her wings and disappears.)
...We didn't even get to talk, and now there are more misunderstandings.
strings.후우, 어쩔 수 없지. 여길 다 뒤져서라도 가브리엘라님을 만나 제대로 이: Whew. No choice. I'll have to search this whole place if that's what it takes to find Gabriella and explain...
Daphne, come out while I'm asking nicely. It's all right. I don't intend to hurt you.
Let's talk this through. We both know Hecate, after all.
strings.(가브리엘라가 입으로 하는 말과는 다르게 앞에 보이는 것들을 발로 차고: (Despite her words, Gabriella kicks and punches apart everything in front of her.)
Sigh. How am I supposed to explain? She doesn't seem the type to listen...
You don't need to be wary of me here.
strings.여전히 의심이 많네요. 그 마음 잠깐 접어 둬요. 다음 일은 다음에 생각: Still so suspicious. Set that aside for a moment. We can think about what comes next later.
There's something I need you to do here.
Why should I do anything for you...?
I came down here to seal Aaron away.
strings.지금 아론은 '별의 눈물'을 노리고 있어요. 전 그걸 미끼 삼아 아론을: Aaron is after the Star's Tear. I intend to use it as bait to seal him away. The odds aren't high, of course. I'll have to trust in luck.
strings.(그 말과 함께 다프네가 고개를 돌려 가브리엘라가 있는 곳을 향해 소리지: (With those words, Daphne turns toward Gabriella and shouts.)
The Star's Tear you're guarding is right here.
strings.(가브리엘라가 소리를 지르며 다프네와 모험가가 있는 곳으로 날아온다.): (Gabriella shouts and flies toward Daphne and the adventurer.)
strings.다프네? 다프네! 뭐야? 어, 어디 간 거야?!: Daphne? Daphne! What? Wh-where did she go?!
strings.손에 들고 있는 별의 눈물, 내놔요!! 어서!!: Hand over the Star's Tear you're holding! Now!
Gabriella, Daphne has disappeared. Let me explain.
Daphne, you've had your last warning.
So this is what she meant by buying time? Sigh...
I am Gabriella, battle angel. By the command of the great god, I shall annihilate you.
strings.(후우, 최대한 버텨 보자….): (Whew. Let's hold out as long as I can...)
strings.(힘을 실은 가브리엘라의 공격이 모험가를 향해 연이어 날아든다.): (Gabriella unleashes one powerful attack after another at the adventurer.)
strings.(조금 전보다 위력이 더 강해진 것 같아.): (Her attacks seem even stronger than before.)
strings.(하아, 하아. 얼마나 버틸 수 있을까….): (Hah... Hah... How much longer can I hold out...?)
strings.이제 포기하고 순순히 운명을 받아들이세요. 천사의 심판을 이 정도까지 버: Give up and accept your fate. To think you've endured an angel's judgment this long...
strings.(그 순간, 공간 전체에 커다란 섬광이 번쩍이며 지진이 난 듯이 요동친다: (At that moment, a brilliant flash fills the entire space, and it shakes as though struck by an earthquake.)
strings.…당신, 왜 다프네 행세를 하고 있었나요?: ...You! Why were you pretending to be Daphne?
strings.(그 순간, %s의 발 밑으로 떨어진 무언가를 가브리엘라가 급히 집어 든: (Gabriella hurriedly picks up something that has fallen at %s's feet.)
strings.(가브리엘라가 깃털을 품에 안고 눈을 감자 흔들리고 있던 공간이 그제야: (Gabriella holds the feather to her chest and closes her eyes. Only then does the shaking stop.)
strings.%s 님, 죄송해요. 정식으로 소개할게요. 저는 가브, 전투 천사 가브리: %s, I'm sorry. Let me introduce myself properly. I'm Gab, the battle angel Gabriella.
strings.혹시 다른 천사들의 기억을 읽으셨나요?: Did you read the other angels' memories?
I learned about Iris, the new God of the Astral Realm, too.
I'm sorry. I had no idea. Gab misunderstood and nearly hurt you.
Gabriella, speak normally. This isn't how you usually are.
strings.후아아, 그래도 될까요? 자매들 생각 나서 오랜만에 이런 식으로 말해봤는: Whew! May I? Thinking of my sisters made me try talking like this for the first time in ages, but it's exhausting.
Oh, right. The Star's Tear! There's no time for this.
strings.(그 말과 함께 가브리엘라 뒤에서 누군가가 지팡이로 어깨를 두드린다.): (At that moment, someone taps Gabriella on the shoulder from behind with a staff.)
strings.(주먹을 휘두르려던 가브리엘라가 그대로 정신을 잃고 바닥으로 쓰러진다.): (Just as Gabriella is about to swing her fist, she loses consciousness and falls to the floor.)
strings.%s, 천사님이 깨지 않게 조용히 해주세요. 시끄럽게 굴면 내가 무슨 짓: %s, keep quiet so you don't wake our angel. Make a fuss, and there's no telling what I might do.
strings.아쉽게도 아론은 봉인하지 못했어요. 이번에는 운이 너무 나빴네요. 어쩔: Unfortunately, I couldn't seal Aaron. My luck was terrible this time. It can't be helped.
It simply means you and I have more to do...
strings.정확히 알 수 없는 고대의 언젠가…. 어떤 생명은 자신을 돌봐 준 신을: Long ago, in an age whose date no one knows... A being wanted to meet the god who had cared for it. So it kept building something in secret.
At last, a great winged ship capable of reaching the realm of the gods was complete.
But there was one small problem. It had no fuel.
strings.그러던 어느 날, 신들이 소멸하고 세계 밖으로 도망가는 시간이 찾아왔어요: Then one day, the time came when gods vanished and fled beyond the world. Those who had once been gods seized the Wings to save themselves.
The method they found to move the Wings, which had sat without fuel...
Was the Star's Tear. A crystal containing the souls of countless lives.
W-wait... Does that mean the gods...?
strings.…옛날이야기는 이제 그만할까요?: ...Shall we leave that old story there?
strings.아론은 곧 날개에 올라 깊고 깊은 신들의 영역으로 향할 거예요. 그리고: Aaron will soon board the Wings and head deep into the realm of the gods. He'll destroy every place that stands in his way.
strings.그곳과 부딪치는 순간, 위대한 벽이 무너지고 에트와르 안에 있는 모든 것: The moment it collides there, the great wall will crumble, and everything within Etoile will be hurled outside.
strings.그렇게 마계의 힘이 들어와 세계에 퍼지겠죠. 마녀의 힘을 손에 넣지 못한: Then the power of the Demon Realm will enter and spread through the world. A rather excessive tantrum for someone who failed to obtain a witch's power, wouldn't you say?
You know the place. Atlas Garden.
strings.%s, 날개가 가동하려면 별의 눈물이 조금 예열되어야 할 거예요. 그래도: %s, the Star's Tear needs to warm up a little before the Wings can operate. Even so, you'd better hurry.
strings.(말이 끝나기가 무섭게 다프네가 흔적도 없이 사라진다.): (No sooner has she finished speaking than Daphne vanishes without a trace.)
I'm all right. But the Star's Tear...
strings.제가 가서 날개가 가동되는 것을 막을게요. 그러니까 가브리엘라 님은 여기: I'll stop the Wings from taking off. Rest here, Gabriella.
The Wings of Icarus... So you know.
(I briefly explain what Daphne told me and what I know about Aaron.)
strings.예전에 이름조차 기억나지 않는 한 분이 계셨어요. 날개가 가동되는 것을: Long ago, there was someone whose name I can no longer remember. They stopped the Wings from operating, and as they vanished, I fled with the Tear.
strings.뒤틀린 자들이 별의 눈물을 노리고 쫓아오고 있을 때, 어딘가에서 커다란: The Twisted Ones pursued me for the Star's Tear. Then a great explosion erupted somewhere, and I fell into the sea.
strings.그 충격으로 사라질 수도 있었지만, 눈을 떴을 때는 아무렇지도 않게 숨을: The impact could have destroyed me, but when I opened my eyes, I could breathe and move as though nothing had happened.
strings.뒤틀린 자가 생명의 영혼을 모아 만든 영혼석인 '별의 눈물'이 생명을 지: The Star's Tear, a soulstone a Twisted One made by gathering living souls, protected an angel who had failed to protect life.
strings.새로운 공간 '지혜의 바다'에 머물 수 있었지만…. 이게 저주인지 축복인: I could stay in this new space, the Sea of Wisdom... But whether a curse or a blessing, I could never return to land.
strings.…그래서 그때부터 별의 눈물을 지키는 것을 사명으로 삼고, 절대 적들에게: ...So from then on, I made protecting the Star's Tear my mission, and swore never to let it fall into enemy hands.
To think I'd lose it like this...
All I can do now is trust you and wait, %s.
strings.(가브리엘라가 %s에게 다가가 살며시 볼키스를 한다.): (Gabriella approaches %s and gently kisses their cheek.)
Don't be surprised. This is my greeting as Gabriella. A sign that I trust you, %s...
strings.위로 올라가면 해안으로 나갈 수 있지만 오래 걸려요. 시간이 없으니까 제: You can reach the coast by going up, but it takes time. Since we're in a hurry, I'll help you.
strings.(가브리엘라가 모험가를 한 손으로 붙잡고 들어 올린다.): (Gabriella grabs the adventurer with one hand and lifts them up.)
strings.생각보다 가벼우시네요. 눈 감고 '나는 새다, 나는 새가 됐다'라고 생각: You're lighter than I expected. Close your eyes and think, 'I'm a bird. I've become a bird.'
I'm going to send you flying out of the sea.
(With a great shout, Gabriella hurls the adventurer upward with all her strength. A whirlpool rises with them.)
...Hurry, %s. My wings may be humble, but they will open the way.
strings.(그레고리가 파도와 함께 허공으로 튀어 오른 모험가를 발견하고는 재빨리: (Gregory spots the adventurer shooting into the air with the waves, then quickly jumps up and catches them.)
strings.(커다란 소리와 함께 모래사장에 착지한 그레고리가 모험가를 내려놓는다.): (Gregory lands on the sand with a great thud and sets the adventurer down.)
strings.후우, 오랜만에 뛰어보는군. 자네, 괜찮은가?: Whew. Haven't jumped like that in a while. Are you all right?
I-I'm alive. Th-thank you, Mr. Gregory.
The angel threw you, didn't she?
strings.내가 천사님을 뵀을 때, 똑같이 그렇게 던지셨다네. 그땐 받아 줄 사람이: She threw me just like that when I met her. Nobody was there to catch me, so I landed headfirst in the sand.
strings.그건 그렇고 들어간 일은 잘된 겐가? 자네 말고 토끼 귀 여인이 밖으로: Anyway, did everything go well down there? I didn't see the woman with rabbit ears come back out...
Grandpa Gregory, something's come up. May I borrow %s?
strings.…전에 말씀드린 유적이 미세하지만, 느린 속도로 움직이고 있는 것 같습니: ...The ruins I mentioned seem to be moving. Very slightly and slowly.
%s, let's hurry. Lady Lena is waiting.
strings.여전히 세상은 믿을 수 없는 일투성이로군. 이 짧은 시간 안에 그런 일: The world is still full of unbelievable things. To think all that happened in such a short time...
%s, there's something I need to tell you... No. Later.
strings.네, 레나 씨. 그런데 사제님, 아직도 사제님이 말씀하신 그 느낌이 다가: All right, Lena. But Father, I still can't sense what you described.
Let me help. May I have your hand? If I use a little divine power...
strings.(아스크렌이 %s의 말에 앞을 바라보자 거대한 그림자가 살라르 해안을 덮: (As Askren looks ahead at %s's words, an enormous shadow falls over Salar Coast.)
Could those be the Wings of Icarus...?
%s, what did you just say? The Wings of Icarus...?
strings.황혼 시절에 뒤틀린 자가 타고 태양을 향해 날아갔던 날개 달린 배. 이카: The winged ship a Twisted One rode toward the sun during the Twilight. The Wings of Icarus... It was supposed to have been destroyed and crashed...
strings.그걸 어떻게 아시죠?: How do you know about that?
Well, the Order's secret records... Oops. Well, I suppose I can tell you, %s.
Lady Lena, you learned this in the course of your mission. I'd appreciate your discretion.
Anyway, I take it you learned about the Wings in the Sea of Wisdom, %s.
strings.사제님, 혹시 그 날개로 가는 방법을 아시나요? 교단 비밀 기록에 그런: Father, do you know how to reach them? Was there anything about that in the Order's secret records?
There was. I happened to see something even the Pope had kept secret. Quite by chance, of course.
strings.「마법사 제레니스가 살라르 해안에 도착했을 때, 날개를 발견했다. 날개는: "When the mage Xerenis arrived at Salar Coast, he discovered the Wings. The Wings guided him, and in the place where they vanished, he saw the past and the future..."
strings.정확히 무슨 말인지는 알 수 없지만…. %s 님, 그 깃털은 뭡니까? 옷: I can't say exactly what it means... %s, what's that feather? It's caught on your clothes...
strings.어, 가브리엘라 님 것인가? 향기가 가브리엘라 님과 비슷한데…. 어, 어: Oh, is it Gabriella's? It smells like her... Huh? Where's it flying?
(Askren and %s look where Gabriella's feather has landed. Directly in front of it stands a strangely shaped structure that was invisible moments ago.)
strings.비공정? 그 날개라는 게 설마 이 비공정을 말한 건가?: An airship? Were the Wings this airship all along?
strings.이렇게 거대한 비공정은 이제껏 본 적이 없습니다. 이렇게 눈 앞에 나타날: I've never seen an airship this enormous. And to think it appeared right in front of us. Ugh.
An invisible wall is blocking the approach.
Maybe only %s can approach? Yes, I can't get through, either.
strings.이 비공정으로 올라가는 길이 보이는데…. 마치 %s 님을 기다리고 있는: I can see a way onto the airship... As though it's waiting for you, %s.
Lena, please keep an eye on things here. I'll be right back.
%s, let me offer a blessing, just in case.
strings.제 기도가 효과가 좋아서 절 아는 분들이 줄 서서 기도해달라고 할 정도거: My prayers work so well that people who know me line up to ask for them.
Sigh. Even at a time like this, Father...
strings.유적의 움직임이 미세하지만, 빨라지는 게 느껴집니다!: I can feel the ruins' movement speeding up, ever so slightly!
I'd better hurry. Lena, Father. I'll be back.
strings.(모험가가 비장한 각오와 함께 비공정 '이카로스의 날개'를 향해 달려간다: (With grim resolve, the adventurer runs toward the Wings of Icarus. The moment they board, the airship vanishes without a trace, as though it had been waiting.)
We should evacuate the people of Nidaros, just in case.
strings.걱정하지 않으셔도 됩니다. '날개'는 다른 영역에 있습니다. 만약 위험한: There's no need to worry. The Wings are in a different realm. Even if something dangerous happens, it will happen only within that realm.
Try trusting us as much as you trust %s.
strings.그래, 믿어 볼게. 하지만, 그게 잘못될 경우 사제님을 비롯해 교단도 책: All right. I will. But if that trust is misplaced, you and the Order will be held responsible...
strings.알고 있습니다. 그런데 그 귀족 청년 말입니다만…. 아, 말하지 말까요?: I understand. Now, about that young nobleman... Or should I not bring him up?
strings.(모험가가 거대한 비공정을 향해 발을 내딛은 순간, 시야에 비치는 풍경이: (The moment the adventurer steps toward the enormous airship, the scene before them changes.)
This looks like some kind of storeroom...
strings.「안녕하십니까? 유일한 선원이자 조타수, 페르디아 인사드립니다.」: "Greetings. Ferdia, sole crew member and helmsman, at your service."
"For a safe journey, all passengers are requested to listen carefully to this announcement."
strings.「본 함은 시간을 넘어 에트와르에 도착한 아스가르드의 기술로 제작되고,: "This vessel is the Wings of Icarus, built with Asgardian technology that crossed time to reach Etoile, and renewed with the spirit of the Silvaria Empire.
strings.「본 함은 현재 목적지 아틀라스 정원으로 향하고 있습니다. 」: "This vessel is currently en route to Atlas Garden."
strings.「도착지까지는 약 X 시간이 소요될 예정입니다. 그동안 승객 여러분께서는: "Estimated travel time is approximately X hours. Until arrival, passengers must observe the following rules."
strings.「1. 승객은 이카로스의 날개의 운항을 방해하지 않는다.」: "1. Passengers shall not interfere with the operation of the Wings of Icarus."
strings.「2. 승객은 이카로스의 날개 안에서 아무런 편의를 제공받지 않는다. 」: "2. Passengers shall receive no amenities aboard the Wings of Icarus."
strings.「3. 승객은 이카로스의 날개의 운항이 끝날 때까지 아무것도 하지 않는다: "3. Passengers shall do nothing until the voyage of the Wings of Icarus is complete."
strings.일방적이잖아. 그렇지 않겠다면?: That's rather one-sided. What if I refuse?
strings.「물의를 일으킬 경우 승객 여러분의 생명은 보장할 수 없습니다.」: "If you cause a disturbance, your survival cannot be guaranteed."
So that was the plan from the start.
strings.「페르디아는 생각하지 않습니다. 학습된 지식과 상황을 바탕으로 최적의 결: "Ferdia does not plan. Ferdia assesses the optimal outcome based on learned knowledge and present circumstances, then acts."
strings.「……아론 선장님? 무슨 말씀을 하시려고….」: "...Captain Aaron? What would you like to say...?"
You came here knowing everything. No point hiding it.
strings.날 만나고 싶은가? 그래, 날 만나고 싶다면 살아서 내가 있는 곳까지 오: You want to meet me? Very well. If you wish to see me, reach me alive.
strings.궁금하군. 이카로스의 날개가 아틀라스 정원에 닿기 전에 네가 날 만나러: I wonder... Can you reach me before the Wings of Icarus arrive at Atlas Garden...?
"With the master's authorization, designated passengers %s and Daphne will be intercepted."
strings.(페르디아의 말과 함께 그림자 속에 숨어있던 적들이 천천히 모습을 드러낸: (At Ferdia's words, enemies hidden in the shadows slowly reveal themselves.)
Fine, Aaron. If that's how you want it, I'll stand in your way to the very end.
strings.(아론이 추락해 파괴된 '날개'의 잔해를 멍하니 바라본다.): (Aaron stares blankly at the wreckage of the crashed Wings.)
The Wings of Icarus crashed... This can't be...
strings.게다가 살라르 해안도 벗어나지 못했다니…. 분명 아틀라스 정원을 향해 날: And we didn't even leave Salar Coast... We were clearly flying toward Atlas Garden...
strings.내가 이면을 찾아내지 못할 리가 없어. 나는 에트와르의 주인이 될 럭스…: I couldn't possibly have failed to detect the reverse side. I am Lux, future ruler of Etoile...
I am Lux's... I am Lux's...
Aaron, you said it yourself. If I wanted to see you, I should reach you alive.
strings.%s…, 대체 어떻게 날개를 멈추고 파괴했지? 이건 일개 인간이 손댈 수: %s... How did you stop and destroy the Wings? This is no device a mere human can tamper with!
I'd like to know how it happened myself...
I waited hundreds of years to set the Wings in motion, only for them to be destroyed so pointlessly...
strings.페르디아를 비롯해 덤벼드는 모든 적을 쓰러뜨렸고, 기체가 추락했어. 그런: I defeated Ferdia and every enemy that attacked me, and the ship crashed. But now we're on the reverse side again...
strings.그것만으로 이렇게 될 리가 없어…. 네놈에게 이 날개를 멈출 지능 같은: That alone couldn't have caused this... You don't have the intelligence to stop the Wings!
strings.무슨 말을 하려는 거야?: What are you trying to say?
How dare you... How dare you...
strings.당신 사정 같은 건 알고 싶지 않은데…. 뭐라고? 망쳤다고?: I don't care about your problems... What was that? Ruined everything?
Looks like there's no other way.
strings.(모험가가 무기를 움켜쥔 순간, 아론이 괴성을 지른다. 동시에 지면이 갈: (As the adventurer tightens their grip on their weapon, Aaron lets out a monstrous scream. The ground splits, and black shadows surge from the cracks.)
I can simply make another plan. I no longer wish to be tied to my original, anyway.
strings.품위라고는 하나도 없는 럭스가 하는 짓이라 이렇게까지는 하고 싶지 않았는: I didn't want to go this far. This is the sort of thing that utterly graceless Lux does...
strings.(모험가를 가로막고 있던 그림자의 벽이 그대로 아론에게 흘러가 엉겨 붙는: (The wall of shadows blocking the adventurer flows toward Aaron and clings to him.)
I'll devour you, then consume the feeble goddess connected to your mind.
strings.럭스가 마계를 정복할 때 사용했던…, 심연의 바닥에 흐르던 원초적인 어둠: The primordial darkness flowing at the bottom of the abyss, which Lux used to conquer the Demon Realm...
strings.모든 걸 삼키고 더럽히는 '그렌델'이다!!: Grendel, who devours and defiles all!
strings.이제 인간의 모습을 한 아론은 없다. 나는 더 이상 럭스의 분신조차 아니: Aaron in human form is no more. I am no longer even an incarnation of Lux...
strings.(그렌델이 이마에 손을 올리자 온몸에 뒤엉킨 어둠이 주변을 삼키듯 퍼져나: (Grendel raises a hand to his forehead. The darkness entwined around his body spreads as though swallowing the surroundings.)
strings.오직 그렌델로서 널 상대해 주지. 절대로 후회하지 않을 심연의 어둠을 선: I will face you as Grendel alone. I shall grant you an abyssal darkness you will never live to regret...
strings.(다시 한번, 그렌델 주위에서 날카롭게 일렁이던 어둠의 칼날이 %s에게: (Once again, the sharp blades of darkness rippling around Grendel fly toward %s. Yet each of his attacks crumbles beneath %s's counterattack.)
I've faced plenty of wicked darkness like this before...
strings.그렌델이든 뭐든, 이런 악한 어둠의 끝은 모두 똑같아!!: Grendel or whatever you call yourself, wicked darkness always meets the same end!
strings.(어둠의 칼날 사이에 틈이 생기자 %s의 공격이 그렌델의 중심을 꿰뚫는다: (A gap opens between the blades of darkness, and %s's attack pierces Grendel's core.)
strings.(살라르 해안의 이면을 가득 채우는 괴성이 퍼지면서 그렌델을 감싸던 그림: (A monstrous scream fills the reverse side of Salar Coast. The shadows wrapped around Grendel flare like flames and scatter.)
strings.크큭. 네가 사라지라고 해서 사라질 내가 아니다. 이 심연의 어둠이 끝까: Heh. I won't disappear just because you tell me to. This abyssal darkness will cling to you and torment you to the end!
strings.(%s의 공격이 그렌델을 관통하지만, 조금 전과 달리 흩어졌다가 다시 뭉: (%s's attack passes through Grendel, but this time he scatters and reforms.)
strings.(이래서는 끝이 나지 않아. 어떻게 하면 좋지? 잠깐….): (At this rate, it'll never end. What should I do? Wait...)
strings.(그렌델의 어둠이 찢긴 틈 사이로 쫑긋거리는 토끼 귀가 보인다.): (Through a tear in Grendel's darkness, a pair of twitching rabbit ears appears.)
strings.다프네, 당신이 끼어들 때가 아니야!: Daphne, this isn't the time to interfere!
strings.(그렌델이 내뿜는 날카로운 어둠의 칼날이 다프네를 향하지만, 다프네의 지: (The sharp blades of darkness Grendel unleashes fly toward Daphne, but disperse like helpless mist before her staff.)
strings.%s, 당신의 힘이 그렌델의 어둠을 많이 갈라놓았군요. 자, 이제 저한테: %s, your power has torn much of Grendel's darkness apart. Leave the rest to me.
strings.당신도 알고 있겠죠? 그렌델이 가진 심연의 어둠을 처리할 방법이 없다는걸: You know it, too, don't you? You have no way to deal with his abyssal darkness.
strings.억지로 악한 어둠에 손댈 필요는 없어요. 이미 더럽혀진 제 손에서 해결하: There's no need to force yourself to touch that evil. Why not leave it to my already stained hands?
strings.언제나 침착하던 아론이 이렇게 본 모습을 드러내다니. 쉽지 않았을 텐데요: The ever-composed Aaron, revealing his true form like this. That can't have been easy.
strings.네가 다른 마녀들의 힘을 취한들, 날 막을 수 있을 줄 아느냐!: Do you think you can stop me just because you've taken other witches' powers?!
strings.그렇게까지 말씀하시다니 칭찬해 드려야겠네요. 어리석은 사람…. 아, 이제: What bold words. I should commend you, foolish man... Oh, you're no longer a man, or anything else.
strings.이 기회에 너도 함께…. 으, 윽? 뭐, 뭐야?!: I'll take this chance to deal with you, too... U-ugh? Wh-what?!
strings.(다프네의 한마디와 함께 그렌델의 모든 움직임이 멈춘다. 심지어 그렌델에: (At Daphne's words, all of Grendel's movements stop. Even the stains of the abyss clinging to him freeze, trapped in time.)
If you hadn't broken your promise, I wouldn't have gone this far.
strings.(다프네가 지팡이를 뻗어 그렌델의 머리와 어깨를 툭툭 두드린다. 그러자: (Daphne reaches out with her staff and taps Grendel's head and shoulders. The darkness supporting him slowly begins to run off.)
strings.괴로워하세요. 고통스러워하세요. 그렇게 소리를 지르면서 무너지세요. 더는: Suffer. Feel the pain. Scream and crumble, until you can never rise again.
strings.이건 사랑하는 나의 아이를 건드린 대가. 내가 분명 말했을 텐데요. 건드: This is the price for touching my beloved child. I believe I warned you... to leave her alone.
To think you'd use the dregs of abyssal darkness that even Lux sealed away.
All the better. I'll make sure you never awaken again, even in the abyss.
strings.그만하자고요? 그럼 그만할까요?: You want me to stop? Shall we end it, then?
strings.(다프네가 다시 지팡이로 그렌델의 머리와 어깨였던 부분을 두드린다. 그러: (Daphne taps what used to be Grendel's head and shoulders again. Darkness drips from him onto the ground.)
strings.도망가지 말아요. 이제 당신이 원하는 대로 끝내야죠. 이게 그렇게 원했던: Don't run. Let's end this just as you wished. This is the witch's power you wanted so badly!
strings.(다프네가 바닥으로 흘러내린 어둠 사이에서 뭔가 움직이는 것을 발견하고는: (Daphne spots something moving in the darkness pooled on the ground. She strikes it with the tip of her staff and pins it down.)
strings.(%s의 일격으로 다프네가 붙잡고 있던 뭔가가 산산이 부서진다. 그러자: (%s's blow shatters whatever Daphne was holding down. The darkness lingering around them slowly disperses like mist.)
Well done, %s. It's a good thing I didn't steal the finishing blow like Barbatos.
Some things I learn whether I want to or not. Especially when they concern you.
strings.제가 벌레를 좋아하지 않아서 대신 맡겼는데, 괜찮죠?: I don't like bugs, so I left it to you. You don't mind, do you?
strings.벌레? 그게 벌레였어?: A bug? That was a bug?
strings.그동안 아론을 이루고 있던 실체를 벌레라고 할게요. 럭스가 만들어낸 분: Let's call the true substance that made up Aaron a bug. At some point, the incarnation Lux created developed a mind of its own and became greedy.
Enough to defy even its original's wishes...
In any case, the bug that grew by devouring so many souls is gone.
strings.원래는 봉인도 고려했지만 이런 방법도 나쁘지 않군요. 럭스가 수를 쓰기: I originally considered sealing it away, but this works, too. We disposed of it before Lux could make his move.
strings.이제 어떻게 할 셈이지?: What are you going to do now?
strings.아, 이거 받아요. 조금 부서지긴 했지만, 천사님이라면 이해해 줄 거예요: Oh, take this. It's a little broken, but I'm sure our angel will understand.
strings.(다프네가 빛을 잃고 갈라진 보석을 %s에게 내민다.): (Daphne holds out a cracked gem that has lost its light to %s.)
There's something I want to ask. About Medea.
Go ahead. I suppose I can tell you about that child.
strings.지금까지 당신이 한 일이 대체 뭘 위한 거야?: What has everything you've done been for?
strings.다 일족을 지키기 위한 일이었어요. 그러다 보니 메디아를 지키는 게 나를: It was all to protect our people. In time, protecting Medea became a way to protect myself and everyone.
So that there would never be another Medea created for that purpose...
But things didn't all go as I wished.
strings.처음엔 신보다 강한 이스트랜드의 마녀로 각성시키려고 했던 그 아이가 신의: I originally intended to awaken her as a witch of Eastland stronger than a god. Instead, she was chosen by a god and became a Transcendent.
After all, everything I've done is for beings like her and me.
strings.그게 정말로 당신의 아이, 메디아 님을 위한 거라고 생각해?: Do you really think this is for your child, Medea?
%s, that is not for you to judge. It's between me and the world.
Now I'll give you the answer you truly want.
The night isn't over yet. Everything rests upon the goddess Hecate's will.
strings.여신의 분노로 인해 상관없는 자들에게 마녀의 운명이 시작됐지만, 끝은 다: The goddess's wrath imposed witches' fates upon those who had nothing to do with it. But the ending will be different.
strings.나는 '바르바토스처럼 신을 죽이러' 갈 거예요. 신이었던 그가 다른 신을: I am going to kill a god, as Barbatos did. Though it will be a little different from when he, a god himself, killed another god and fell.
At first, I only meant to use him briefly. Now we've become part of each other's plans.
If possible, I'd like him to know true despair... Hehe.
strings.자, %s. 이제 저는 생명으로서, 저에게 영향을 끼친 신에게로 향할 거: Now, %s. As a living being, I will go to the god who shaped my life. Do not interfere. For the sake of all those who died as witches...
strings.…누구보다 진심으로 보이지 않았나요? 후후. 조금 더 진심을 다해야겠군요: ...Did I not seem more serious than anyone? Hehe. I'll have to show a little more resolve.
strings.큰 적이 하나 사라졌지만, 당신에게는 아직도 싸워야 할 대상이 남아있어요: One great enemy is gone, but you still have others to fight. Let me offer you a choice.
strings.신을 죽이려는 자들과 맞서 싸우다 죽을 건지, 아니면 아무것도 하지 않고: Will you fight those who seek to kill gods and die, or do nothing and live?
strings.후자라면 제가 도와드릴 수 있어요. 아무것도 기억하지 못하는 평범한 에트: If you choose the latter, I can help. Making you an ordinary resident of Etoile who remembers nothing would be simple...
I refuse. That wouldn't be me.
strings.좋아요. 그럼 저는 다음 만남을 기다릴게요. 하지만 끝이 어떻게 될지는: Very well. I'll look forward to our next meeting. Though I can't promise how it will end.
I can no longer help you. Let me wish you luck one last time.
If you can survive until then, of course...
strings.(다프네가 작은 미소를 보이며 손을 흔드는 순간, 흔적도 없이 모습이 사: (Daphne gives a small smile and waves. In that instant, she vanishes without a trace.)
strings.…잠깐, 다프네!! 묻고 싶은 게 더 있어!! 판도라 님은 어디에 있는…: ...Wait, Daphne! I have more questions! Where is Pandora...?
What's the right choice? Sigh. I don't know... Let's get out of here first...
strings.그런데 어떻게 나가야지?: But how do I get out?
"Route guidance error. Recalculating route. Please state your destination."
strings.「페르디아는 승객 여러분을 위해 준비된 내비게이션 시스템입니다. 종착지를: "Ferdia is a navigation system provided for our passengers. State your destination, and I will guide you along the fastest route."
strings.(분명 파괴하고 움직이지 않는 것까지 확인했는데…. 이카로스의 날개가 추: (I destroyed it and made sure it had stopped moving... The Wings of Icarus crashed and shattered. How is it working again?)
strings.「목적지가 입력되지 않을 경우, 가장 안전한 곳으로 경로를 자동 탐색합니: "If no destination is entered, a route to the safest location will be calculated automatically."
strings.「살라르 해안의 이면에서 살라르 해안의 정면으로 가는 길은 현재 위치에서: "The route from the reverse side of Salar Coast to the ordinary side lies ten steps from your current position, toward the sea."
strings.「현재 자동 모드로, 승객 여러분을 지정된 장소로 바로 이동합니다.」: "Automatic mode is now active. Passengers will be transported directly to the designated location."
strings.잠깐, 방금까진 걸어가라더니 바로 이동이야?: Wait. First you said to walk, and now you're transporting me?
strings.「내비게이션 '페르디아' 시스템 종료. 이카로스의 날개 운항을 종료합니다: "Navigation system Ferdia shutting down. Operation of the Wings of Icarus is now concluded."
strings.「다시 만나서 반가웠습니다. 주인님….」: "It was a pleasure to see you again, Master..."
Hey, Father! You're the one who needs to get a grip! Look, they're breathing perfectly well.
strings.오, 오늘 저희는 사랑하는 %s 님을 여신님 품으로 돌려보내며 영원한 안: T-today we return our beloved %s to the goddess's embrace and p-pray for eternal rest.
O light of e-eternal rest, shine upon %s...
strings.으아아아아!! 사, 살아났다. 호, 홀리!! 신께서 제 기도를 들어주셨습: Aaaaaah! B-back to life! H-holy! God has answered my prayers!
strings.하아, 이 정신 나간 사제님아!! 살아있는 사람을 함부로 천국으로 보내지: Oh, you mad priest! Stop sending living people to heaven!
Hahahahaha! I'm glad you returned safely. I've come back to my senses, too.
strings.그런데…, 제가 어떻게 여기까지 왔죠?: But... how did I get here?
strings.대체 무슨 일이 있으셨죠? 이제 다 끝난 건가요? 설마, 이것 때문에 정: What happened? Is it all over now? Did this make you lose consciousness?
strings.(아스크렌과 레나가 이카로스의 날개에서 일어났던 이야기를 듣고 놀란다.): (Askren and Lena listen in surprise to the account of what happened aboard the Wings of Icarus.)
Is everything involving the Empire over now? Ah...
strings.미안. %s. 나는 폐하를 모시는 은의 발톱 요원으로서 그 점을 먼저 생: I'm sorry, %s. As a Silver Claw agent serving Her Majesty, I couldn't help thinking of that first.
The Empire owes you another great debt, %s.
strings.저기, 사제님. 혹시 사제님도 이면에 대해 알고 계세요?: Father, do you know about the reverse side?
strings.존재 자체는 알고 있습니다. 하지만, 그게 어떤 방식으로 나타나는지, 어: I know it exists. But I don't really know how it appears or how to reach it.
strings.다만, 나름의 방법으로 %s 님을 살라르 해안의 이면으로 모실 수 있어서: Still, I'm glad we could arrange our own way to bring you to the reverse side of Salar Coast, %s.
Father, when you said 'us,' did you mean...?
strings.오래전 고대 엘프 용사들께선 나쁜 마족을 퇴치하면서 주민들에게 피해가 가: Long ago, ancient elven heroes fought evil demons while striving to keep the villagers safe.
strings.그 과정에서 우연히 이면이라는 공간을 발견했고, 그곳에서 싸우면 주민들에: In doing so, they happened upon a space called the reverse side and learned that fighting there would not affect the villagers.
strings.한때 이름을 날렸던 마족들이 소리 소문 없이 사라졌다면 거의 이면에서 쓰: If a once-famous demon vanished without a trace, it most likely fell on the reverse side.
strings.그 이후로 각 엘프 마을의 촌장들이 이면을 발견하는 법을 비밀리에 후손들: Since then, the chiefs of each elven village have secretly passed down the method of finding it to their successors.
strings.그럼, 살라르 해안의 이면은 어떻게 발견하셨나요?: Then how did you find the reverse side of Salar Coast?
Stellan sensed something ominous first and took action...
strings.저를 통해 다른 마을과 연결해 유적이 이면으로 움직일 수 있게 조치했습니: Through me, he contacted other villages and arranged for the ruins to move to the reverse side.
strings.…그 과정에서 평범한 엘프일 뿐인 아저씨께서 마력과 생명력을 거의 소진해: ...In the process, Stellan, who was only an ordinary elf, exhausted nearly all his magic and life force. And he passed away.
strings.어떻게든 아저씨를 살리고 싶었지만, 신조차 쉽게 넘을 수 없는 삶과 죽음: I wanted to save him somehow, but at the boundary between life and death, which even gods cannot easily cross, there was nothing I could do.
strings.그저 편히 잠드시기를 빌고 또 빌었죠. 마을 걱정, 딸 걱정뿐이던 분이셨: I could only pray and pray that he would rest peacefully. All he worried about was the village and his daughter...
It's difficult now, but someday I intend to tell Embla everything...
That must be hard for you, too, Father.
strings.하하, 괜찮습니다. 레나 경께서 제 머리에 총구를 들이미신 것만 빼고 말: Haha, I'm all right. Aside from Lady Lena pointing a gun at my head, of course.
First, I need to return this to the angel.
strings.다시 바다에 풍덩 빠질 생각인가요?: Are you planning another plunge into the sea?
strings.…한 번 해봤으니 괜찮겠죠? 그러는 레나 씨는요?: ...I've done it once, so it should be fine, right? What about you, Lena?
I'll return to Glaston and report to Her Majesty. But not just yet.
strings.만일을 대비해 니다로스에서 며칠 머물면서 상황을 지켜보려 해. 할 일도: I plan to stay in Nidaros for a few days and watch the situation, just in case. I have things to do, too...
strings.폐하께서도 니다로스에 머물면서 애시 웨이브 한 잔 즐길 여유 정도는 허락: I'm sure Her Majesty will allow me enough leisure to enjoy an Ash Wave while I'm here.
strings.아, 결국 그거였군요. 그러면 글래스턴으로 돌아갈 때 함께 가요. 저도: Oh, so that's what this is about. Let's return to Glaston together, then. I think I need some rest, too.
strings.두 분께서 돌아가실 때까지 니다로스 마을에서 '제대로' 쉴 수 있게 돕겠: I'll make sure you both get a 'proper' rest in Nidaros until you leave.
Then I'll change it to 'reasonable.' Haha.
strings.레나 경, 이왕 말이 나와서 말인데…. 제가 어떻게 '적당히' 도울지 한: Lady Lena, since you brought it up... Would you like to hear how I plan to offer 'reasonable' assistance?
I'll see you both in the village later. I'm going to see the angel.
strings.그레고리, 오랜만이에요. 당신을 보니 그때가 생생히 떠오르네요. 그때 그: Gregory, it's been a long time. Seeing you brings it all back so clearly. Did you defeat that demon?
It was beyond my abilities, so I borrowed someone else's help...
I should have sent it flying properly.
strings.아닙니다. 그때 천사님께서 큰 도움을 주셨지요. 그런데, 여기까지 어떻게: Not at all. You were a great help. But how did you come up here? I thought you couldn't...
strings.드디어 바깥 공기를 맞을 수 있게 됐어요. 그래도 이 경계를 벗어나진 못: I can finally feel the air outside again. Though I still can't cross this boundary.
strings.그레고리, 걱정해 줘서 고마워요. 그동안 니다로스 주민들 기도 덕에 버틸: Thank you for worrying, Gregory. The prayers of Nidaros's people have kept me going. It's all thanks to you.
I meant, is it all right for you to reveal yourself like this...?
strings.보통 사람들에게는 보이지 않으니까 괜찮아요. 그리고 제가 아끼는 분들이: Ordinary people can't see me, so it's fine. And I'll only appear when people I care about come by.
strings.자네 왔나. 음, 천사님과 할 이야기가 있는게로군. 잠시 자리를 비켜드리: You're here. Hmm, you have something to discuss with the angel. I'll give you a moment.
strings.그레고리, 제 이름은 가브리엘라예요. 다음에 여기서 제 이름을 불러주세요: Gregory, my name is Gabriella. Next time, call my name here.
strings.그때의 기억이 너무 꿈같아 이름조차 여쭤보지 못했죠. 고맙습니다, 가브리: What happened then felt so dreamlike that I never even asked your name. Thank you, Gabriella.
strings.(그레고리가 가브리엘라에게 조용히 목례하고 뒤로 물러난다.): (Gregory gives Gabriella a quiet bow and steps back.)
strings.가브리엘라 님, 어떻게 밖으로 나오셨죠?: Gabriella, how did you get outside?
strings.아마도 별의 눈물에 생긴 균열이 저를 묶고 있던 무언가를 지운 모양이에요: I think the crack in the Star's Tear removed something that was binding me.
strings.조금 이상한 기분이 들긴 하지만, 좋게 생각하려고요. 활동 반경이 몇백: It feels a little strange, but I'm choosing to see it positively. I'm delighted to have more room to move after hundreds of years.
I'd like to see how my sisters are doing, but that will have to wait.
strings.그럼 별의 눈물은 어떻게 되는 거죠?: What happens to the Star's Tear now?
There are no longer any ruins in this world for it to power, but I must keep guarding it.
strings.수많은 생명의 영혼이 녹아 있는 이 물건이 다른 곳에 잘못 쓰일 수도 있: Something holding so many living souls could still be misused elsewhere.
strings.아직 제 사명은 끝나지 않았어요. 제가 사라질 때까지 전처럼 '지혜의 바: My mission isn't over. Until I disappear, I will keep protecting the Star's Tear in the Sea of Wisdom.
strings.(그 말과 함께 가브리엘라의 손에 있던 별의 눈물이 작은 물방울 수십 개: (As she speaks, the Star's Tear in Gabriella's hand turns into dozens of tiny droplets and evaporates.)
strings.놀라지 마세요. 안전한 곳으로 돌아간 것뿐이에요. 혹시라도 이리스 님께서: Don't be surprised. It's simply returned to a safe place. If Iris ever asks for it, I'll give it to her at once.
I hope that day comes soon.
strings.저요? 조금 쉬었다가 돌아갈 생각이에요. 글래스턴을 거쳐 이리스를 만나러: Me? I'll rest a little, then head back. I'll pass through Glaston and go see Iris. We need to discuss what to do next...
My sisters seem to have heard Iris's message as soon as they met you, %s... But she hasn't said anything yet.
strings.이리스…. 이리스…. 이리스, 듣고 있어?: Iris... Iris... Iris, are you listening?
strings.(이 일 때문에 위대한 벽에 영향이 갔나? 조용하네.): (Did this incident affect the great wall? She's quiet.)
She'll speak when the time is right.
strings.가브리엘라 님, 저는 이만 돌아갈게요. 종종 와서 다른 천사님 소식 전해: Gabriella, I'll head back now. I'll visit and bring news of the other angels.
strings.고맙습니다. %s 님. 목적지까지 편히 가실 수 있게 던져드리고 싶은데…: Thank you, %s. I'd like to throw you to your destination to make the journey easier...
I'm fine. I'd rather not land headfirst in the sand.
strings.후후, 아쉽네요. 그럼 천사의 인사로 대신 해도 괜찮을까요?: Hehe, what a shame. Then may I offer an angel's greeting instead?
strings.(가브리엘라가 %s에게 다가가 살며시 볼키스를 한다. 그리고는 다가오는: (Gabriella approaches %s and gently kisses their cheek. Then she yields to an incoming wave and slowly disappears into the sea.)
The angel's left, so I suppose you're finished talking.
strings.살다 보니 이런 날도 있구만…. 무슨 일이 있었는지 궁금하네만, 조용히: To think I'd live to see a day like this... I'm curious what happened, but I'll keep my questions to myself.
In any case, it's a relief that nothing bad happened...
Ah, right. I meant to tell you this.
strings.언제가 될지 모르지만, 일이 풀리지 않아 답답하다면 날 찾아오게. 큰 힘: Whenever things aren't going your way and you feel stuck, come see me. I may not be much help, but I can do something.
It's kind of you to offer, Mr. Gregory.
Come on, let's head back. We're being watched... Ah, a slip of the tongue.
Don't mind me. Just a slip of the tongue.
Shall we go, then? Mr. Gregory, let me carry that fish for you.
Are you sure you can lift it? If you're not careful, it could crush you to death.
strings.으아아아, 그레고리 씨. 사, 살려 주세요. 이, 이거 왜 이렇게 무거워: Aaaaaah! Mr. Gregory! H-help! Why is this so heavy?
strings.(살라르 해안가 절벽 위, 그 광경을 지켜보고 있던 누군가가 조용히 은화: (Atop the cliffs of Salar Coast, someone watching the scene quietly toys with a silver coin.)
strings.토끼 마녀가 귀찮은 럭스의 발을 묶었군. 덕분에 그 시간이 가까워졌나?: The rabbit witch has tied up that troublesome Lux. Has that brought the moment closer?
Hehe. Now to drag down the goddess clinging so precariously to her perch...
